about: Where each piece of the Command frame goes and how it is cut. slice = left, top, right, bottom in pixels (null: not stretched). today = the class of Assets/Kapman/Game/UI/Frame.uss, or the sign drawn in code, that shows this piece in the game now (empty: nothing shows it yet). The game takes Art/final/<file> when it is there, else Art/placeholder/<file>. uss = the elements of the frame that take the piece, as Frame.uss writes them (classes, :hover and :active; several with commas; empty: no element takes it). lay = fill (the background, cut in nine), over (a layer on top), icon (in place of the element's own drawing). A piece is laid only when it is in Art/final.
